I had been looking for a cover like this for a while now. I had to move my machines to a more exposed area on the side of my house. This cover fits well but is a bit thin. My biggest concern was protecting rain damage. This seems to work for that so far. It doesn’t really protect the back at all though. It’s more for the front and top of the machines.

When I first got it I was concerned it wouldn’t be large enough. Once I opened it I realized it was thin but size-wise it fit just right. I have a standard size older washer that loads from the top. I like that this is versatile enough to be used for front or top loading. You could realistically use this for other items to protect them as it doesn’t have a firm shape to it. It’s more of a tarp that had a zipper in it.

Overall it works well enough. I’m not sure it will last forever but for now, it’s done well in keeping rain exposer to a minimum. Price-wise I think it’s relatively fair.

We bought this because when it rains, the washer gets filled with rain water. It’s outside, so it’s exposed to the elements. Since buying this, no issues with rain getting into the drum, and washer is completely protected.

Pleased with quality and thickness of material. Function is good with the zippers to expose control panel and front door.

The cover is NOT 31"W X 31"D, as advertised. However, it fits my dryer almost perfectly, so I'm happy. My dryer is only 29" wide and 26" deep. The vertical measurement from top of control panel is about 41", as advertised. However, it's a couple inches short of covering the entire vertical sides of my dryer. (See pics)

Not that easy to install since you have to reach around the back to tie the thongs together. My dryer had lots of clear space on both sides. If not, I would have had to pull it out to secure the cover by thing the thongs together in the back.

Regarding complaints about waterproof-ness: The material itself is pretty waterproof. After installing, I sprayed with hose and water did not go through the fabric. However, if exposed to heavy rain/wind, water could go through the zippers, and certainly through the very top, which is only held together by 3 tabs of velcro. Still, I think it is a reasonable design that will protect the dryer from most rain events.

I would definitely buy again.
